properties.name: app.datasource.olap.url
properties.description: JDBC URL of the OLAP database.

properties.name: security.jwt.shared-secret
properties.description: Shared HMAC secret used to sign and verify access tokens.

properties.name: market-data.fauxnance.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the Fauxnance market data API.

properties.name: market-data.fauxnance.api-key
properties.description: API key for the Fauxnance market data API.

properties.name: market-data.refresh.priority-symbols
properties.description: Comma-separated ticker symbols refreshed on the priority schedule.

properties.name: market-data.refresh.priority-poll-ms
properties.description: Delay between priority quote refreshes in milliseconds.

properties.name: market-data.refresh.secondary-poll-ms
properties.description: Delay between secondary quote refreshes in milliseconds.

properties.name: market-data.kafka.enabled
properties.description: Enable Kafka quote publication and consumption.

properties.name: market-data.kafka.quote-cache-max-age-ms
properties.description: Maximum quote cache age in milliseconds.

properties.name: market-data.execution.kafka.topic
properties.description: Kafka topic for order execution commands.

properties.name: market-data.execution.kafka.group-id
properties.description: Consumer group for order execution commands.

properties.name: etl.schedule.cron
properties.description: Cron schedule for OLTP to OLAP loads; a hyphen disables scheduled loads.
